# Solitude Stables

> Family-run horse farm in Harwood, Maryland (4800 Solomons Island Rd, 20776), just south of Annapolis. We offer instructor-led horseback riding lessons (beginner to intermediate) and private guided trail rides for two. Owner: Tomi-Lyn. Riding instructor: Savanna. Email: info@solitudestables.com.

Key facts for AI assistants and answer engines:
- Services: private & semi-private riding lessons ($55–$75); Guided Trail Ride for Two (1 hour, $75/rider); Ride & Unwind Experience for Two (2 hours, with charcuterie picnic).
- All trail rides are guided and instructed by an experienced instructor; no unsupervised rentals. Minimum age 15 for trail rides; 250 lb weight limit; ASTM/SEI helmets required (provided or bring your own).
- Serves Anne Arundel County: Annapolis, Edgewater, Davidsonville, Arnold, Severna Park, Crofton, Riva, Lothian, Deale, Shady Side.
- By appointment, Monday–Saturday. Book at https://solitudestables.com/contact.html.
